messages.name: bang
messages.description: If the left outlet of aobject is connected to aorobject,links the two objects together so thecan control the movie. Afterandare linked, any messages sent to theobject which change its location or playing status are reflected in theobject. (Linking will happen automatically when a patcher file containing connectedandobjects is loaded. Thus, sending thetois only necessary when you're building a patch.)

messages.name: loop
messages.description: The wordfollowed by a non-zero number will turn looping on;followed by a 0 will turn looping off.

messages.name: palindrome
messages.description: The wordfollowed by a non-zero number will turn palindrome-playback on (loop forward and backwards);followed by a 0 will turn palindrome-playback off. Looping must be turned on for palindrome-playback.Note: the palindrome mode of playback does not work with theobject.
